items.title: Don Albert and Herbert Hall Interview, 1978-08-03
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Did you listen to the trumpet player ever with old man Robichaud? [INTERVIEWEE]: Yeah. I was. Mutt. Oh, was Mutt with him? I didn't think so.

ctx.x: But it didn't click. I don't know why, either.
Not that it was a bad band. Yeah. Did you listen to the trumpet player ever with old man Robichaud?
Yeah. I was. Mutt. Oh, was Mutt with him? I didn't think so.
